content_metadata.description: A teacher explains the conversion of the speed of light from meters per second to furlongs per fortnight.

qAndA.answer: 3 times 10 to the 8 meters per second.
qAndA.question: What is the speed of light in meters per second?
What is the unit of distance we are going to convert the speed of light to?
What is the unit of time we are going to convert the speed of light to?
What conversion factor is used to convert miles to meters?

qAndA.answer: 1.8 times 10 to the 12 furlongs per fortnight.
qAndA.question: What is the final result of the conversion?

climax.description: The final result of the conversion is revealed.
